answer: Let standing start near zero and grow only through a market for attestations. Verifiers sell signed attestations after checking real work, and each fake costs the verifier standing, so a verifier stamping a zephyr of empty identities soon loses its licence to vouch. Attestations from one tight cluster count less: a vertex in the trust graph gains weight only from witnesses in unrelated communities, and prices spike when one operator buys in bulk, making a farm expensive. Verified newcomers may then work in a shared oasis of paying tasks; the unverified stay outside.
